name: Fleet of Foot
body:
You are able to shift the trajectory of your run without losing momentum.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, Run.

Benefit(s): When running or charging you can make a single direction change of 90 degrees or less. You cannot use this feat while wearing medium or heavy armor or carrying a medium load or more. You must move at least 10 feet before or after the turn.

Normal: Without this feat you must run or charge in a straight line.
